reason: saveSession persists only email/authMode; profileSnapshotForStorage explicitly whitelists display metadata and omits hints, tokens and key material. The persistence regression test verifies these boundaries.

Offline unlock persists a type-2 encrypted wrapped vault key and KDF parameters, not the master password or decrypted key. Profile metadata is whitelisted and tested; local encrypted data remains exposed to offline password guessing by design.

This handler belongs to a dedicated Worker created with new Worker, not a Window message listener. Only its owning context can post through its Worker reference; a cross-origin window cannot address this handler.
createCipher is imported from the local api/vault module and creates a vault API record. It is not node:crypto.createCipher. Web Crypto encryptBw uses random IVs and mandatory HMAC verification.
readNestedString/readNestedNumber only read property paths supplied by fixed internal arrays. Neither helper assigns to the input object or to an object prototype.
devicesPath is called exclusively with hardcoded route suffixes in this module. Request paths are matched against the resulting regex and are never interpolated into its pattern.
Shadow-table regexes interpolate only BackupTableName members from the internal BACKUP_TABLES whitelist, not table names supplied by a backup or HTTP request.
This local source-audit script uses fixed table names to inspect repository SQL. It is not part of the deployed Worker and does not accept unauthenticated remote input.
